Subjective: Analytic point of power series, C0!=0 for binious series, 2 matrix ke Wronskian, Linear independent differential equation ka general solution, Chauchy Euler equation, 4x² d²x/dy² + ... y=0 ka general solution, matrix ka eigenvalues find karna.
